nodes.label: Parity Gate
nodes.rationale: Release gate ensuring Rust feature pipeline reproduces Colab pandas feature engineering bit-for-bit before live trading is enabled

nodes.label: CausalConv1d
nodes.rationale: Causal 1D convolution ensuring predictions at time t only depend on t and previous timesteps, preventing future information leakage

nodes.label: MarketMarkovNet Neural Architecture
nodes.rationale: 6-layer causal CNN backbone with GroupNorm and SiLU, parallel draft heads for 1H/4H/24H horizons, and low-rank Markov heads modeling sequential dependencies between horizons

nodes.label: Feature Engineering Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Computes log_return, TR/ATR(72), typical price, VWAP, vwap_dev with rolling z-score normalization for gradient stability

nodes.label: Stage 1: Backbone Pre-training
nodes.rationale: Freeze Markov heads, train backbone only with multi-task MSE loss to learn feature extraction without temporal consistency concerns

nodes.label: Stage 2: Markov Alignment Fine-tuning
nodes.rationale: Unfreeze all layers with reduced learning rate, using DirectionalTemporalLoss combining MSE, directional hinge margin, and temporal consistency loss

nodes.label: DirectionalTemporalLoss
nodes.rationale: Custom loss combining MSE, directional hinge margin error penalizing wrong directional predictions, and temporal consistency loss penalizing deviations between sequential horizon predictions

nodes.label: Hysteresis Swing Backtester
nodes.rationale: Entry signals when both 4H and 24H predictions align above magnitude_threshold (0.50%), using ffill for sticky positions to reduce turnover and capture longer swings

nodes.label: Regime-Filtered Swing Backtester
nodes.rationale: Adds 200-hour SMA regime filter: long entries only in bullish regime (close > SMA), short entries only in bearish regime, creating asymmetric signal generation

nodes.label: Low-Rank Markov Heads
nodes.rationale: Model sequential dependencies between prediction horizons (1H influences 4H, 4H influences 24H), capturing Markovian nature of market movements across timeframes

nodes.label: Rolling Z-Score Normalization
nodes.rationale: Rolling window normalization for features like log_return, atr_72, vwap_dev to ensure gradient stability and prevent large-scale features from dominating learning

nodes.label: Deployment Security Model
nodes.rationale: Only proxy publishes ports 80/443, all services non-root, models mounted read-only, inference has no secrets, Caddy handles ACME, TLS certs persist in volume

nodes.label: Kraken Permissions Matrix
nodes.rationale: Query + Trade only, Withdraw MUST be disabled to prevent lateral movement on compromise. Includes Query Funds, Open/Closed Orders, Ledger, Export Data, Place/Cancel Orders

nodes.label: Borrowing Over Cloning
nodes.rationale: Prefer &T over .clone() unless ownership transfer needed. Clone traps: auto-cloning in loops, cloning large structures, cloning due to bad API design

nodes.label: Copy Trait Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Small Copy types (<=24 bytes, 2-3 words) can pass by value. Structs should be Copy only if all fields are Copy, small, and represent plain data without heap allocations

nodes.label: Option/Result Pattern Matching
nodes.rationale: Use match for inner type matching, let-else for early returns with default values, if-let-else when divergent code needs extra computation. Use ? to propagate Err when Err value is not needed

nodes.label: Iterator Patterns
nodes.rationale: Prefer iterators for transforming collections, for loops for early exits and side effects. Iterators are lazy and fused at compile time. Avoid needless intermediate collections

nodes.label: Prevent Early Allocation
nodes.rationale: Use _else variants (map_or_else, unwrap_or_else, ok_or_else) when allocation or function calls are needed to avoid eager evaluation

nodes.label: Clippy Linting Discipline
nodes.rationale: Run cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings daily. Use #[expect(clippy::lint)] over #[allow(...)] with justification. Configure workspace lints in Cargo.toml

nodes.label: Performance Mindset
nodes.rationale: Don't guess, measure. Always use --release flag. Profile with cargo flamegraph before optimizing. Avoid redundant cloning, prefer iterators over manual loops, avoid intermediate collections

nodes.label: Stack vs Heap Allocation
nodes.rationale: Keep small Copy types on stack, avoid passing >512 bytes by value, heap allocate recursive data structures with Box. Use smallvec for large const arrays

nodes.label: Zero-Cost Abstractions
nodes.rationale: Rust iterators compile to efficient tight loops. Prefer iterators over manual for loops for collections. Avoid intermediate .collect() calls when passing to functions accepting impl Iterator

nodes.label: Error Handling with Result
nodes.rationale: Prefer Result<T,E> over panic. Use thiserror for library errors with From trait derivation, anyhow only for binaries. Use ? operator for error propagation. Avoid unwrap/expect in production

nodes.label: Automated Testing Practices
nodes.rationale: Descriptive test names reading like sentences, one assertion per test, use modules for organization. Tests serve as living documentation. Doc tests with /// double as documentation and correctness checks

nodes.label: Generics and Dispatch
nodes.rationale: Static dispatch (impl Trait, generics) for zero runtime cost via monomorphization. Dynamic dispatch (dyn Trait) only when heterogeneous collections or runtime polymorphism needed. Prefer static until trait needs pointer

nodes.label: Type State Pattern
nodes.rationale: Encode system states as types not runtime flags. Invalid states become compile errors. Uses PhantomData for state management. Applied in builder pattern with compile-time guarantees and network protocol state machines

nodes.label: Comments vs Documentation
nodes.rationale: // comments explain why (safety, workarounds, design rationale). /// doc comments explain what and how for public APIs. Comments rot and mislead - prefer ADRs, design docs, and doc comments. TODOs must link to issues

nodes.label: Pointer Types and Thread Safety
nodes.rationale: Send for cross-thread data movement, Sync for shared cross-thread access. &T shared readonly, &mut T exclusive mutable, Box<T> heap owned, Arc<T> atomic ref counted multi-thread, Mutex<T>/RwLock<T> thread-safe interior mutability
